name: npm-automations
description: Runs an async npm ci when a package-lock.json project is entered via EnterWorktree (toggle: npm_ci_on_worktree), and an async, dependency-scoped npm install whenever a package.json's dependencies actually change (toggle: npm_install_on_package_change) — moved out of coding-toolbox to centralize npm-lifecycle automation hooks.

npm_ci_on_worktree.title: Auto npm ci on worktree entry
npm_ci_on_worktree.description: When entering a git worktree (EnterWorktree) whose project has a package-lock.json, runs npm ci there in the background. Values: true (or unset) = enabled; false = disabled. Fail-open: only the literal value false disables it. Default: true.

npm_install_on_package_change.title: Auto npm install on package.json dependency change
npm_install_on_package_change.description: After a Write/Edit to any package.json whose dependencies/devDependencies/optionalDependencies actually changed, runs npm install scoped to only the changed specs in the background — a version-only (or other non-dependency) change triggers no npm call. Values: true (or unset) = enabled; false = disabled. Fail-open: only the literal value false disables it. Default: true.
